lines.text: I am in no way inferior to the super-apostles, and signs, wonders, and miracles were performed among you.
I am ready to come a third time and will not be a burden, seeking you, not possessions.
Brothers should save up for their sisters, and I will gladly spend my money and myself for your souls.

wrong_details.wrong: Brothers should save up for their sisters
wrong_details.true: Parents should save up for their children

lines.text: I urged Timothy to visit you, and I asked whether he exploited you.
I fear quarreling, jealousy, and gossip, and that my God will humble me before you when I come again.
